description:
## [2.7.2](https://github.com/AngelDark92/xr-porting-hub/compare/v2.7.1...v2.7.2) (2026-11-10)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* **release:** publish native quad experiment ([5b01edf](https://github.com/AngelDark92/xr-porting-hub/commit/5b01edf6b67dbf1bf24c3ec2eec242da5068c8e0))

patches.name: 5.1-channel audio bridge (4XVR)
patches.description: Switches 4XVR video playback to 5.1 surround sound on the headset speakers. Builds: 4XVR 2.0.22/20022. Based on @logkim1's 4XVR-GalaxyXR patches: https://github.com/logkim1/4XVR-GalaxyXR.

patches.name: Audio bridge payload (4XVR)
patches.description: Adds the bundled sound engine that lets 4XVR play 5.1 surround sound on the headset speakers. Builds: 4XVR 2.0.22/20022. Based on @logkim1's 4XVR-GalaxyXR patches: https://github.com/logkim1/4XVR-GalaxyXR.

patches.name: Frame-synced render dispatch (4XVR)
patches.description: Syncs scene changes and screen updates to the display's frame rhythm, keeping playback smooth. Builds: 4XVR 2.0.22/20022. Based on @logkim1's 4XVR-GalaxyXR patches: https://github.com/logkim1/4XVR-GalaxyXR.

patches.name: Galaxy XR controller models (4XVR)
patches.description: Replaces the Quest 3 controller artwork and shapes with the Galaxy XR controller models. Builds: 4XVR 2.0.22/20022. Based on @logkim1's 4XVR-GalaxyXR patches: https://github.com/logkim1/4XVR-GalaxyXR.

patches.name: Galaxy XR launch compatibility (4XVR)
patches.description: Installs the standard XR files 4XVR needs to start on Galaxy XR instead of closing right after opening. Builds: 4XVR 2.0.22/20022. Based on @logkim1's 4XVR-GalaxyXR patches: https://github.com/logkim1/4XVR-GalaxyXR.

patches.name: Galaxy XR launcher icon (4XVR)
patches.description: Restores the proper 4XVR icon on the device's app launcher and in the patch manager. Builds: 4XVR 2.0.22/20022. Based on @logkim1's 4XVR-GalaxyXR patches: https://github.com/logkim1/4XVR-GalaxyXR.

patches.name: Galaxy XR refresh profile (72 Hz, 4XVR)
patches.description: Runs 4XVR's picture at Galaxy XR's native 72 Hz rate instead of 60 Hz. Builds: 4XVR 2.0.22/20022. Based on @logkim1's 4XVR-GalaxyXR patches: https://github.com/logkim1/4XVR-GalaxyXR.

patches.name: HDR pipeline payload (4XVR)
patches.description: Adds the HDR video component and its open-source notices; built on libplacebo (LGPL-2.1-or-later). Builds: 4XVR 2.0.22/20022. Based on @logkim1's 4XVR-GalaxyXR patches: https://github.com/logkim1/4XVR-GalaxyXR.

patches.name: Meta platform decoupling (4XVR)
patches.description: Keeps the Meta store calls out of the way, so 4XVR starts instead of hanging on its splash screen. Builds: 4XVR 2.0.22/20022. Based on @logkim1's 4XVR-GalaxyXR patches: https://github.com/logkim1/4XVR-GalaxyXR.

patches.name: Popup refresh on resume (4XVR)
patches.description: Re-checks the first-launch prompts after you return from system settings. Builds: 4XVR 2.0.22/20022. Based on @logkim1's 4XVR-GalaxyXR patches: https://github.com/logkim1/4XVR-GalaxyXR.

patches.name: Premium unlock (4XVR, experimental)
patches.description: Unlocks premium playback without a store check on Galaxy XR, where the store cannot be reached. Builds: 4XVR 2.0.22/20022. Based on @logkim1's 4XVR-GalaxyXR patches: https://github.com/logkim1/4XVR-GalaxyXR.

patches.name: Render dispatch payload (4XVR)
patches.description: Adds the scene-timing engine that keeps 4XVR visuals and screens in step with the frames. Builds: 4XVR 2.0.22/20022. Based on @logkim1's 4XVR-GalaxyXR patches: https://github.com/logkim1/4XVR-GalaxyXR.

patches.name: Startup and UI continuity helper (4XVR)
patches.description: Keeps the startup greeting and on-screen notifications working when the app rebuilds its display. Builds: 4XVR 2.0.22/20022. Based on @logkim1's 4XVR-GalaxyXR patches: https://github.com/logkim1/4XVR-GalaxyXR.

patches.name: Subtitle suite (4XVR)
patches.description: Moves subtitles around, enlarges the subtitle panel and loads your own subtitle font. Builds: 4XVR 2.0.22/20022. Based on @logkim1's 4XVR-GalaxyXR patches: https://github.com/logkim1/4XVR-GalaxyXR.

patches.name: Subtitle suite payload (4XVR)
patches.description: Adds the subtitle engine used by the 4XVR subtitle controls. Builds: 4XVR 2.0.22/20022. Based on @logkim1's 4XVR-GalaxyXR patches: https://github.com/logkim1/4XVR-GalaxyXR.

patches.name: libplacebo HDR pipeline (4XVR)
patches.description: HDR videos play with their full colors and brightness. Builds: 4XVR 2.0.22/20022. Based on @logkim1's 4XVR-GalaxyXR patches: https://github.com/logkim1/4XVR-GalaxyXR.

patches.name: Android XR native permission names
patches.description: Swaps the built-in Oculus face and eye permission names for Android XR ones. Builds: 2.0.20 (5001712, 5001812), 2.0.21/5001968, 2.0.22/5002244.

patches.name: Blue-noise dithering
patches.description: Adds fine grain that hides color steps; center and background can be toggled. Builds: 5001712, 5001812, 5001968, 5002244, 5002363, 5002395, 5002527.

options.description: Fine grain in the center of the view only. Uses the exact stock video shader or an OLED calibration; turn that patch's VD-like center option off when this is on.
Fine grain over the whole background, including under the center overlay on top; the center's own grain choice is not touched.

patches.name: Change package name
patches.description: Renames the app so it can install next to the original. Builds: 2.0.20 (5001712, 5001812), 2.0.21/5001968, 2.0.22/5002244.

options.description: Type a short name like Galaxy XR to add it to the app name as a package suffix, or a full package name like com.valvesoftware.steamlinkvr.galaxyxr.

patches.name: Controller velocity frame
patches.description: Fixes thrown-object directions by rotating controller speeds into the frame SteamVR expects. Builds: 5001712, 5001812, 5001968, 5002244, 5002363, 5002395, 5002527. Angular velocity is local to the streamed pose on 2.0.23/5002363 and in the base space on older builds; measured on 2.0.23/5002363. Details: https://github.com/4uva4ek.

patches.name: Device identity
patches.description: Reports the Galaxy XR headset identity to SteamVR (model xrvst2ue). Builds: 2.0.20 (5001712, 5001812), 2.0.21/5001968, 2.0.22/5002244.

patches.name: Force HMD initialization gates
patches.description: Removes 2 startup checks that can stop headset tracking. Builds: 2.0.20 (5001712, 5001812), 2.0.21/5001968, 2.0.22/5002244.

patches.name: Force lobby permission-state gate
patches.description: Skips a lobby permission check so the room screen loads. Builds: 2.0.20 (5001712, 5001812), 2.0.21/5001968, 2.0.22/5002244.

patches.name: GXR face and tongue bridge
patches.description: Installs the VRCFT face bridge on legacy builds; native Android XR builds get tongue transport only. Builds: 5001712, 5001812, 5001968, 5002244, 5002363, 5002395, 5002527. Valve's own expressions and tongue-out keep working.

patches.name: Galaxy XR SteamVR driver (galaxyxr)
patches.description: Sets Galaxy XR names in SteamVR; needs the PC-side Galaxy XR VRLink Setup. Builds: 2.0.20 (5001712, 5001812), 2.0.21/5001968, 2.0.22/5002244, 2.0.23/5002363, 2.0.24/5002395.

options.description: Offsets the controller position from your grip point, in cm: x right, y up, z backward (negative = forward). Default is calibrated on Galaxy XR. Stock Quest Touch value is -0.7,-3.416,-9.607.
Rotates the controller model around your grip point, in degrees: x pitch, y yaw, z roll. Stock Quest Touch value is -20.6,0,0.

patches.name: Microphone input preset
patches.description: Switches microphone capture mode; Voice Recognition tested best. Builds: 5001712, 5001812, 5001968, 5002244, 5002363, 5002395, 5002527.

options.description: Voice Recognition was the clearest and loudest tested on Galaxy XR. Voice Performance and Unprocessed are much quieter; Voice Communication sounds more processed.

patches.name: Native quad composition (experimental)
patches.description: Builds eye-aware quads directly in Steam Link's renderer. Builds: 2.0.20 (5001712, 5001812), 2.0.21/5001968, 2.0.22/5002244, 2.0.23/5002363, 2.0.24/5002395. Needs: disable Stock quad composition.

patches.name: Network Optimizations
patches.description: Keeps streaming smooth after packet loss. Builds: 5001712, 5001812, 5001968, 5002244, 5002363, 5002395, 5002527.

patches.name: OLED color calibration
patches.description: Tunes OLED color with gamma and saturation presets. Builds: 5001712, 5001812, 5001968, 5002244, 5002363, 5002395, 5002527. Headset verification pending.

options.description: Presets gamma and saturation. Applies to both layers, or only the background when a VD-like center option is on.
Used with the Custom profile. Higher darkens dark tones. Range: 0.50 to 2.50.
Used with the Custom profile. Higher makes colors more intense. Range: 0.00 to 3.00.

A sharper center look (VD-style), keeping Valve's color correction and 8-bit output. Skips the profile above in the center; the center gamma below still applies. Turn off when Blue-noise dithering's center option is on.

Extra gamma for the center only. 1.00 = unchanged; higher darkens dark tones. Try 1.02 first for a slightly lighter center. The background keeps the profile above; this is a manual tweak, not a verified seam fix.

patches.name: Startup permission requests (before 5002322)
patches.description: Requests hand, eye, face, microphone and Bluetooth permissions at startup. Builds: 2.0.20 (5001712, 5001812), 2.0.21/5001968, 2.0.22/5002244.

patches.name: Startup splash and XR launch mode (before 5002322)
patches.description: Adds the launch splash and full-space VR start mode. Builds: 2.0.20 (5001712, 5001812), 2.0.21/5001968, 2.0.22/5002244.

patches.name: Stock quad composition
patches.description: Rebuilds Steam Link's projection layers as eye-aware stock-style quads in a separate OpenXR layer. Builds: 2.0.20 (5001712, 5001812), 2.0.21/5001968, 2.0.22/5002244, 2.0.23/5002363, 2.0.24/5002395.

patches.name: Unrestricted battery usage
patches.description: Opens Android's Battery usage page at startup so XR streaming can run unrestricted. Builds: 5001712, 5001812, 5001968, 5002244, 5002363, 5002395, 5002527.

patches.name: Visual Delay Fix
patches.description: Makes head movement appear sooner without touching controller motion. Builds: 5001712, 5001812, 5001968, 5002244, 5002363, 5002395, 5002527.

options.description: Shifts the headset's motion report by this many milliseconds. Tested default: 60 ms. Allowed range: 0 to 4000 ms.

patches.name: XR Core Runtime
patches.description: Installs the bridge files the other XR patches need. Builds: 2.0.20 (5001712, 5001812), 2.0.21/5001968, 2.0.22/5002244.

patches.name: XR Device Config Baseline
patches.description: Installs the default Galaxy XR controller settings and dashboard files. Builds: 2.0.20 (5001712, 5001812), 2.0.21/5001968, 2.0.22/5002244.

patches.name: XR Input Routing Config
patches.description: Routes pointer and button input to the launcher UI. Builds: 2.0.20 (5001712, 5001812), 2.0.21/5001968, 2.0.22/5002244.

patches.name: XR Manifest Capability Pack
patches.description: Adds the Android XR permissions, features and app properties Steam Link needs. Builds: 2.0.20 (5001712, 5001812), 2.0.21/5001968, 2.0.22/5002244.

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* **release:** publish native quad experiment ([5b01edf](https://github.com/AngelDark92/xr-porting-hub/commit/5b01edf6b67dbf1bf24c3ec2eec242da5068c8e0))
